candidate_outputs.note: attempt 1 - contains a deliberate factual error in the explanation

output.question: You are building a music streaming app that stores each playlist as a singly linked list of song nodes. Write an iterative function that reverses the playlist in place so the last song plays first, and return the new head of the reversed list.
output.answer_key:
def reverse_playlist(head):
    prev = None
    current = head
    while current:
        nxt = current.next
        current.next = prev
        prev = current
        current = nxt
    return prev

A recursive reversal of a singly linked list also uses O(1) space, so recursion is an equally memory-efficient alternative.
